{{Top|leg}}
The '''Supreme Governor''' was the leader of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]]. After the revolution on Apsolon, [[Ewane]] became the first [[Workers]] to attain the position. He was killed shortly into his second term in office. He was succeeded by his close friend, and [[Civilized]], [[Roan]], who later was also murdered. After Roan's death, his brother [[Manex]] was selected as the new ruler of the planet.
